// A caller can push a second source with the same id into a Measurement's list. Combining must still
// merge the duplicates and validate their sigma, exactly as when every operation copied its sources.
import std.measurements

fn main() -> Void {
    a = measurements.from_source(10.0, 0.5, "s", "shared").unwrap()
    b = measurements.from_source(3.0, 0.5, "s", "shared").unwrap()
    a.sources.push(b.sources[0])
    print(a.sources.length())
    scaled = measurements.scale(a, 1.0)
    print(scaled.sources.length())
    print(scaled.sources[0].contribution)
    shrunk = measurements.scale(a, 0.1)
    print(shrunk.sources.length())
    print(shrunk.sources[0].contribution)
    summed = measurements.add(a, measurements.exact(1.0)).unwrap()
    print(summed.sources.length())
    print(summed.sources[0].contribution)
    c = measurements.from_source(10.0, 0.5, "t", "shared").unwrap()
    d = measurements.from_source(3.0, 0.7, "t", "shared").unwrap()
    c.sources.push(d.sources[0])
    rejected = measurements.scale(c, 1.0)
    print(rejected.known)
    print(rejected.reason)
}
